content: किरणः [कृ--क्यु <ls>Uṇ. 2. 81</ls>] .²1 A ray or beam of light, a ray (of the sun, moon or any shining substance); रविकिरणसहिष्णु <ls>Ś. 2. 4</ls>; एको हि दोषो गुणसंनिपाते निमज्जतीन्दोः किरणेष्विवाङ्कः <ls>Ku. 1. 3</ls>; <ls>Śānti. 4. 6</ls>; <ls>R. 5. 74</ls>; <ls>Śi. 4. 58</ls>; ˚मय radiant, brilliant. .²2 A small particle of dust. .²3 The sun.
